title: Order the Phases of an Audit and Penetration Test
prompt: Put the steps in the correct chronological order, from the audit charter to corrective follow-up.

items.label: Audit charter, frequency, and scope definition
Data collection: sampling, questionnaires, interviews, assertions
Gap analysis and benchmarking against the target framework
Engagement scoping: test type and rules of engagement
Passive reconnaissance followed by active reconnaissance
Penetration testing and controlled exploitation of vulnerabilities
Reporting, recommendations, and tracking corrective actions

explain: First scope (charter, scope), then collect and compare (gap analysis), define the engagement and ROE, perform passive then active reconnaissance, test, and finally report and track remediation. Corrective follow-up closes the improvement loop.
